info.title: SimRecipes API
info.description: The versioned public application contract for SimRecipes. Authentication: Authorization: Bearer <token>. Errors use {"error": {"code", "message", "details"}}. Collections are returned as {"data": [...], "links", "meta"}. See docs/API.md and docs/MCP.md.

get.summary: Get a recipe with moderation fields

get.description: Administrators only; unrestricted first-party token required.

post.description: Exchanges a verified Apple identity token for an unrestricted first-party bearer token (ability `*`). Rate limited per IP.
Works with any valid token, including read-only personal access tokens.

get.summary: Get a camera model with capabilities

put.summary: Add a recipe to a collection

delete.summary: Remove a recipe from a collection

post.description: Model Context Protocol endpoint. Accepts a read or write scoped personal access token; tools are filtered by scope. Own rate limit bucket. GET and DELETE return 405. See docs/MCP.md.

400.description: Invalid JSON-RPC request or unknown tool.

patch.description: Returns 201 when the profile is created by this call, 200 when updated.

post.summary: Create or update my profile (POST alias)

get.description: Private drafts, published recipes and copies, newest first. Cursor pagination.
Requires an unrestricted first-party token; personal access tokens cannot manage tokens.

post.description: The secret is returned once. Requires an unrestricted first-party token.
Idempotent. Unavailable when either user blocked the other.

get.description: Authorized against the owning recipe. Private images are only served to their owner with a read-scoped token.

delete.summary: Delete an image of a private recipe
delete.description: Images of published recipes are immutable (403).

get.description: Public; returns only published recipes. Page-number pagination (existing contract). Order is deterministic.
Published recipes are public. A valid bearer token with the read scope additionally lets the owner read their private recipes.

patch.description: Published recipes are immutable (403). POST is accepted as an alias for multipart clients.

post.summary: Copy a published recipe into the library
post.description: Creates a new private recipe with provenance. Supports the Idempotency-Key header.
Requires at least one image. The recipe becomes immutable.

get.description: Up to 6 recipes for the same camera model, ranked by shared categories, tags and settings. Not paginated by design.

post.description: Public. Authenticated viewers are deduplicated for 15 minutes; anonymous clients may send X-Anonymous-Key.

bearerAuth.description: Sanctum bearer token. Tokens from Sign in with Apple have the ability `*`; personal access tokens carry `read` and/or `write`. Each operation lists the required scope in x-token-scope (`full` means an unrestricted first-party token).

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor from meta.next_cursor of the previous response.

Search.name: search
Search.description: Free text over name, description, recommendation and tags (max 100 characters).

CameraModelId.name: camera_model_id
CameraModelId.description: Only recipes for this camera model ULID.

FilmSimulation.name: film_simulation
FilmSimulation.description: Only recipes whose film_simulation setting equals this value.

CompatibilityEvidence.name: compatibility_evidence
CompatibilityEvidence.description: Minimum evidence level of every setting; requires camera_model_id.

Categories.name: categories[]
Categories.description: Category IDs or slugs; any match.

Tags.name: tags[]
Tags.description: Tag IDs or slugs; any match.

LibraryStatus.name: status
LibraryStatus.description: Only private drafts or only published recipes.

LibrarySearch.name: search
LibrarySearch.description: Free text over name, description and recommendation.

LibraryCamera.name: camera_model_id
LibraryCamera.description: Only recipes for this camera model ULID.

ImageVariant.name: variant
ImageVariant.description: thumbnail, detail or original (default depends on visibility).

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Stable key (8-128 chars of letters, digits and . _ : -) for one logical operation. A retry with the same key and payload returns the original result with Idempotent-Replayed: true; a different payload is rejected with idempotency_key_reused.

Unauthenticated.description: Authentication is required or the token is invalid, expired or revoked.

Forbidden.description: Not allowed: the token lacks the required scope (insufficient_scope) or a policy denies the action (forbidden).

NotFound.description: The resource does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with current state, or an identical idempotent request is still running.

ValidationError.description: Validation failed (validation_failed) or the request is not processable (unprocessable, idempotency_key_reused, invalid_idempotency_key).

RateLimited.description: Rate limit exceeded; see the Retry-After header.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the next request is allowed.

CollectionList.description: The caller's collections in display order (not paginated; bounded per user)

AccessTokenCursorPage.description: Cursor page of personal access tokens (secrets are never included)

CreatedAccessTokenResponse.description: Created token including its one-time secret

RecipeImageBinary.description: The image bytes. Private recipe images are only served to their owner.

McpResult.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 response (or 202 for notifications). See docs/MCP.md.

CursorMeta.description: Cursor pagination metadata. Pass next_cursor as the cursor query parameter to fetch the next page; null means there are no more items.

value.description: String, number, boolean or object, as allowed by the camera capability.

RecipeExampleContext.description: Author-supplied labels for a real example photo; never inferred by the application.

capture_metadata.description: Location is included only when location_shared is true.

token.description: Unrestricted first-party bearer token. Treat as a secret.
The secret bearer token. Shown exactly once, never stored in clear text and never returned again.

context.description: Type-specific summary of the reported item.

name.description: Display name, used only when the account is created.

settings.description: Validated against the camera model's capabilities (GET /cameras/{camera}). Replaces all existing settings on update. In multipart requests send a JSON-encoded string.

images.description: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 25 MB each. Multipart requests only.

capture_metadata.description: JSON array aligned by index with images; each item is null or RecipeCaptureMetadata.

example_context.description: JSON array aligned by index with images; each item is null or RecipeExampleContext.

CreateRecipe.description: Send as application/json (no images) or multipart/form-data (with images).
